view.label: View school settings
view.description: See the school's name, logo, working hours and the settings change history.

edit.label: Edit school settings
edit.description: Change the school's name, logo, language and working hours.

manage.label: Manage stages
manage.description: Add, rename and switch off stages.

view.label: View the activity log
view.description: See who did what and when, across the system and in each record's history.

view.label: View users
view.description: See the user accounts, their roles and their employee records.

manage.label: Manage users
manage.description: Add and edit user accounts, give them roles, deactivate them and set temporary passwords.

view.label: View roles
view.description: See the roles and the permissions each one grants.

manage.label: Manage roles
manage.description: Add custom roles and change which permissions a role grants, and for which rows.

manage.label: Manage event deliveries
manage.description: See event deliveries that failed for good and send them again.

view.label: View notification settings
view.description: See the school's default for each kind of notification and how long notifications are kept.

manage.label: Manage notification settings
manage.description: Change the school's default for each kind of notification and how long notifications are kept.

view.label: View the HR dashboard
view.description: See the HR summary on the home page: the figures of the screens this role can also open (employees, payroll, penalties). Without any of those, the home page shows links to the role's screens.

view_analytics.label: View the dashboard charts
view_analytics.description: See the charts on the home page: payroll cost, headcount, penalties and lateness, and deductions over the last 6 or 12 months. Each chart also needs the permission of the screen its figures come from, and amounts need the right to see salaries.

view.label: View employees
view.description: See the employee list and profiles.

view_salary.label: View salaries
view_salary.description: See employees' salaries and pay details.

change_status.label: Deactivate and reactivate employees
change_status.description: Mark an employee as having left, or bring them back.

view.label: View HR lists
view.description: See departments, job titles and employee grades.

manage.label: Manage HR lists
manage.description: Add, rename and switch off departments, job titles and employee grades.

view.label: View HR rules
view.description: See work days, hours, lateness and penalty rules.

edit.label: Edit HR rules
edit.description: Change work days, hours, lateness and penalty rules.

manage.label: Manage the penalty catalogue
manage.description: Add and edit penalty groups and violations.

view.label: View penalties
view.description: See recorded penalties and their status.

record.label: Record penalties
record.description: Record a penalty for an employee. It goes to the stage head of the stage where it happened, then to HR.

approve.label: Approve penalties
approve.description: The HR step: approve a penalty waiting for HR, which fixes its level and deduction, or reject it with a reason.

cancel.label: Cancel penalties
cancel.description: Cancel a penalty, giving the reason.

review.label: Review penalties (stage head)
review.description: Approve, with an optional note, or reject, with a reason, a penalty recorded in your stage before it goes to HR.

view.label: View contracts
view.description: See employees' contract history and the renewal season.

manage.label: Manage contracts
manage.description: Renew contracts, record that one isn't renewed or the employee's notice, decide early termination and end a contract. Never your own.

edit.label: Enter lateness
edit.description: Enter and correct each month's lateness minutes.

recalculate.label: Recalculate payroll
recalculate.description: Recalculate a draft payroll run after changes.

adjust.label: Adjust payroll
adjust.description: Add and remove bonuses and deductions on a draft run.

approve.label: Approve payroll
approve.description: Approve a payroll run; it can no longer change.

export_bank_sheet.label: Export the bank sheet
export_bank_sheet.description: Download the bank transfer sheet of an approved run.

view.label: View accounting rules
view.description: See the payroll tax rule: income-tax slices, the martyrs' fund and the insurance share.

edit.label: Edit accounting rules
edit.description: Change the payroll tax rule: income-tax slices, the martyrs' fund and the insurance share.

view.label: View payroll taxes
view.description: See each approved month's insurance, income tax, martyrs' fund and gross per employee.

return.label: Return payroll to HR
return.description: Send an approved month back to HR as a draft, with a reason, before the salaries are transferred.

finalize.label: Finalize payroll
finalize.description: Mark an approved month's salaries as transferred. A finalized month can't go back to HR.
